pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Select-Only Combobox pattern: a non-editable combobox that controls a single-select listbox.

aria.value: Label id, then the combobox's own id (name = label + selected label)
true when the listbox is shown
id of the active option while open; removed when closed
Help text and visible error message ids
"true" only while an error message is shown

keyboard.action: Opens; activates the selected option or the first enabled option.
Opens; activates the selected option or the first enabled option.
Opens; activates the selected option or the last enabled option.
Opens if needed; activates the first / last enabled option.
Typeahead: opens if needed and activates the next option whose label starts with the typed text; repeated characters cycle; Space continues a query in progress.
Moves the active option, skipping disabled options, without wrapping.
Selects the active option, closes, emits aui-change if the value changed.
Closes without changing the value; does not reach a surrounding Dialog.
Selects the active option, closes, and moves focus.
Moves focus to and from the combobox (not in the tab order when disabled).

focus: DOM focus always stays on the combobox; options are never focused (pointer interaction with the popup is prevented from moving focus). The combobox shows a focus-visible outline; the active option has a visible outline that does not rely on color alone and is scrolled into view.
notes: The label is a <label> associated through aria-labelledby because a div is not labelable; clicking the label focuses the combobox.
The required asterisk is aria-hidden; required state is conveyed by aria-required.
Errors appear after the first blur by default so users are not interrupted.
Disabled selects use aria-disabled and tabindex=-1, per the APG guidance for disabled comboboxes.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
